title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
Our mission
We're making Africa the first cashless continent.
In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason-the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.
We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.
Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How you'll help us achieve it
We're looking for a CTO who wants to own engineering end to end: the systems, the people, and the standards for a company whose work changes lives.

Keep us moving fast as we get bigger: We deliberately favour fewer processes, simple designs, and deeply understood tools, because that's what lets a small team operate a system this important. Your job is to protect that as the headcount grows and ensure more ownership per engineer, and a clear view of where complexity is worth the tradeoff.
Own reliability: Wave is the financial system for tens of millions of people. You'll set the standards for uptime, incident response, and how carefully we change things that move money and you'll be accountable when we fall short.
Build and lead the leadership layer: You'll inherit 5 direct reports and an engineering organization of ~100 people including security, data and inf

title: Digital Marketing Engineer
description:
Digital Marketing EngineerQuick Overview
We are searching for a talented and creative individual to plan, create, and manage, successful digital marketing campaigns.
Who is Hite Digital

Hite Digital is a Digital Marketing Agency that is hyper-focused on People first and our Services second. Our number one goal is to create a work environment that lifts people up, helps develop them, and empowers them to perform at their best.
By focusing on our people first, our goal is enabling our team to 100% focus on our clients and the services we provide them all geared towards helping small businesses scale across the US.
What is the role of a Digital Marketing Engineer @ Hite Digital ?
We call this role the brains of what we do at Hite Digital because our client's success or failure will boil down to how you manage the accounts, from setting up a great foundation to optimizing properly.
This position will manage up to 40 clients across different marketing channels like Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and Meta Ads, among others. These clients vary in industry and can be both local lead generation-focused and eCommerce centric.
The Digital Marketing Engineer is the lead strategist of the different marketing campaigns set forth for our clients and as such will coordinate with Account Managers who manage relationships with clients to ensure all parties involved are aware of the account’s progress, challenges, and wins.
Key Responsibilities

• Facilitates the client onboarding experience by understanding the client, their industry, and their marketing goals and combining that with market research to draft go-to-market campaign strategies.

• Conducts keyword, audience, competitor, and audience research to develop and optimize regular marketing campaigns on channels like Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Microsoft Ads.

• Develops ad copy content for different marketing campaigns and channels and can provide creative direction to designers who will aid in the development of marketing assets.

• Is responsible for managing paid media budget without overspending but is proactive and strategic about suggesting when budgets should be increased, decreased, or shifted based on performance needs and client goals.

• Identify CRO opportunities: Provide suggestions on website or landing page content that may help drive campaign conversion rates, including suggestions for offers, promotions, and user experience enhancements.

• Provides suggestions on product titles and descriptions where appropriate.

• Communicates progress, challenges, and wins via regular updates, including monthly reports and client-facing calls where appropriate.

• Collaborates with team members: coordinates with Account Managers, Web Designers, and Account Managers to provide the best client experience possible.

• Ensure proper campaign performance and return on investment measurement by installing and maintaining tracking measurements through softwares like GA4, WhatConverts, Call Rail, among others.

Requirements

• Fully Bilingual in Spanish & English

• BS/MS degree in marketing, business administration, or a related field

• 3 years of experience managing Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and Meta Ads as a minimum

• Highly creative with experience in identifying target audiences and devising digital campaigns that engage, inform, and motivate

• Strong analytical skills and data-driven thinking

• Strong communication skills

• Managing analytical software like GA4, Microsoft Clarify

title: Lead Customer Success Manager, Strategic Accounts | ANZ
description:
Who are we?

HubSpot is a leading customer platform that brings marketing, sales, service, and operations tools together to help businesses attract, engage, and delight customers. It's our mission to not just help them grow, but to help them grow better. Our global team builds with heart, curiosity, and a drive to solve for the customer while doing work that matters.

We value flexibility, autonomy, and results over where you’re located. This role is open to remote workers anywhere in Australia, with our ANZ office based in Sydney’s CBD.

What’s the role?

The Strategic Accounts team at HubSpot services our highest-paying and most complex customers. This team is responsible for coordinating the post-sale customer experience, enabling customers to achieve outcomes and making the value they’re getting out of HubSpot visible as a way of driving usage, desired outcomes, retention and growth.

As a Lead Customer Success Manager (CSM) on the Strategic Accounts team, you will work with a wide variety of primarily corporate/enterprise-sized businesses. You will be responsible for driving product adoption of existing tools, removing roadblocks, proactively managing risk, and identifying opportunities for new products and services within your book of business. You’ll work with a broad number of stakeholders, including leadership, to learn how their teams function and the challenges they face, and help set them up for long-term growth. 

In this role, you will:

• Oversee the customer experience for a portfolio of approximate 35 enterprise-level, high-value accounts with the goals of retention and growth.

• Build and foster deep relationships at all levels of the customer organisation, multi-tasking with customers to ensure alignment with their business goals and use cases and develop long-term partnerships.

• Use strategic thinking, consultative problem solving, and deep product knowledge to help your customers achieve measurable business outcomes, new use cases and maximize their ROI with HubSpot. 

• Partner with multiple internal cross-functional teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Contract Management, and HubSpot executive leadership) to develop and execute success plans that align stakeholders on growth strategies and risk mitigation.

• Create and deliver Executive Business Reviews, presentations and strategic consultations to align on goals, priorities, growth opportunities, and overall business vision to support optimal adoption of the HubSpot platform.

• Act as a customer advocate and focus on deep platform solutioning, by developing adoption roadmaps, identifying and removing technical and cultural adoption barriers, creating and delivering success plans with clear outcomes, aligning internal resources to support customer initiatives - all while demonstrating resilience and perseverance in the face of setbacks or slow progress.

• Travel onsite to deliver strategic consulting engagements if needed, usually around 2-3 times yearly.

• Demonstrate a sustained, significant, and quantifiable impact on the business in the areas of program development, team growth and/or people development. 

We are looking for people who have:

• A personal investment in helping customers succeed.

• Experience working with large organizations (200+ employees)

• Experience managing a minimum of $5-6M ARR

• A proven track record of measurably impacting customer results through creative problem-solving, strategic consulting, and change management. Experience in doing this with SaaS platforms is desired.. 

• Exceptionally strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to multithread across stakeholders and deliver compelling executive-level presentations. 

• Comfortability with navigating change.

• Project management expertise, including planning and executing strategic initiatives.

• Experience with risk management, account retention, and renewal strategies.

• An autonomous, proactive approach

title: Staff Accountant, Corporate Accounting & Consolidations - Full Time, Days
description:
Be a part of a world-class academic healthcare system at UChicago Medicine as a Staff Accountant. This position will be primarily a work-from-home opportunity, with the requirement to come onsite as needed.
The Staff Accountant, Corporate Accounting & Consolidations, is responsible for supporting the accurate and timely preparation of accounting records and financial reporting activities for the University of Chicago Health System and its related entities and partnerships. The Staff Accountant supports the monthly close process through the preparation of routine journal entries, account reconciliations, and financial schedules related to investments, debt, insurance, eliminations, and joint venture activities.
The Staff Accountant assists with quarterly and annual financial reporting, audit support, and other Corporate Accounting activities. The role works closely with members of Corporate Accounting, Treasury, and other departments to obtain information, resolve routine accounting questions, and ensure transactions are recorded accurately and in accordance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
The position is expected to perform established accounting processes with increasing independence while escalating complex or non-routine accounting matters to senior team members. The role requires strong attention to detail, organization, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines in a collaborative environment.
Essential Job Functions

• Prepare routine monthly journal entries and supporting documentation for assigned accounting areas, which may include:

• Investment transactions, including income accruals, amortization, accretion, valuation adjustments, and gains/losses.

• Insurance prepaid and accrual activity.

• Entity eliminations and intercompany activity.

• Joint venture and partnership activity, including recording financial information provided by external partners.

• Bonds and debt service, including interest accruals, debt issuance cost amortization, and debt service payments.

• Grants and pledges, including recording, reconciling, and reporting related activity.

• Perform established accounting processes in accordance with GAAP and department procedures.

• Participate in the monthly close process by completing assigned tasks accurately and within established deadlines.

• Research and resolve accounting discrepancies, escalating complex or unusual items to senior team members.

• Prepare monthly account reconciliations for assigned investment, insurance, elimination, joint venture, debt, grants, pledges, and related accounts.

• Analyze account activity and investigate variances and reconciling items.

• Maintain accurate and organized supporting documentation for journal entries and reconciliations.

• Assist with roll-forward schedules and other supporting schedules used in financial reporting and audit activities.

• Follow up with internal departments and external parties as needed to obtain supporting information.

• Assist with the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting schedules.

• Support the preparation of bond and debt compliance reports by providing assigned financial information and supporting schedules.

• Assist with quarterly and annual financial statement close and reporting activities.

• Provide requested schedules, documentation, and account support for interim and year-end financial statement audits.

• Assist with maintaining audit schedules and responding to routine audit requests.

• Support the preparation of consolidated financial reporting by completing assigned accounting and reconciliation activities.

• Participate in special projects and operational improvement initiatives as requested by leadership.

• Assist with documenting accounting processes and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and accuracy.

• Support other members of the Corporate Accounting team with routine accounting and reporting activities as needed.

Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Waymo Safety team works to promote and help to continuously improve the safety of Waymo’s fully autonomous driving technology. Our experts develop safety goals and strategies, and conduct safety engineering analyses to ensure safety is being considered throughout the design and development of our vehicles. The team develops and promotes safety strategies and policies for autonomous vehicles for its work with regulatory authorities, lawmakers, law enforcement and public and non-profit organizations. Our Safety Team also helps advise on compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety regulations.

This role follows a hybrid work schedule and reports to the Safety Management System Lead.

In the Senior Safety Management System (SMS) Analytics Specialist role, you will lead how Waymo measures and reports on the performance of its Safety Management System. This role sits at the intersection of data analytics and executive governance: you will develop and synthesize reliable metrics across our safety processes, increase awareness and understanding of SMS performance data, and translate complex trends into recommendations for senior leaders. When metrics highlight areas for improvement, you will partner across teams to ensure owners are assigned and solutions deliver measurable results. In this role, your work will directly drive continual improvement across Waymo’s safety programs.

You will:

• Develop Reliable Safety Performance Indicators: Design and refine SMS implementation, maturity, and effectiveness metrics grounded in industry best practices and international safety standards, assessing and maintaining metric quality and advising teams and leaders on proper metric interpretation and use.

• Map & Synthesize Multi-Domain Safety Management Metrics: Collect, quality-assure, and synthesize quantitative and qualitative metrics across multiple business functions and trace them to the company’s top-line safety objectives.

• Run SMS Performance Reporting Governance: Lead the processes and analytics workflows used to support executive leadership review of SMS performance data and aggregated trend analyses.

• Translate Signals into Executive Decision Material: Partner with data science, operational, and safety teams across Waymo to distill complex multi-source data into clear, decision-oriented briefings, dashboards, and continual-improvement recommendations for senior leaders.

• Drive Closed-Loop Action & Effectiveness Tracking: Monitor safety performance indicators against targets and thresholds; where indicators show adverse trends or fall short of targets, confirm an accountable owner is assigned and track action items through to verified closure and confirmed effectiveness.

• Scale Analytics Tooling & Audit Readiness: Define requirements for data collection, visualization, and reporting tools that improve the reliability and scalability of SMS performance measurement, and support preparation for domestic and international regulatory audits and evaluations.

title: Engenheiro Analítico Sênior (DBT / GCP)
description:
A Leega é uma empresa focada no atendimento eficiente e inovador em seus clientes.
Isso não poderia ser diferente com o nosso principal combustível: as pessoas!
Nossa cultura é inspiradora e nossos valores estão presentes no dia a dia: ética e transparência, excelência de qualidade, trabalho em equipe, responsabilidade econômica, social e ambiental, relações humanas e credibilidade.
Buscamos profissionais inovadores que sejam movidos por desafios e focados em resultados.
Se você busca uma empresa dinâmica e parceira e que investe em seus colaboradores através de capacitação constante, a Leega é o lugar para você!
>> A LEEGA É PARA TODOS, ficaremos muito felizes em ter você em nosso time. Venha fazer parte da nossa história e da construção do nosso futuro.
Cadastre-se agora mesmo em nossas vagas!
Buscamos um Engenheiro Analítico Sênior para atuar em uma instituição financeira, construindo a camada de transformação e consumo de dados em ambiente Google Cloud. O profissional será responsável por levar o dado da origem até o dashboard, com qualidade, performance e controle de custo.
A atuação envolve contato direto com áreas de negócio não técnicas: entender a pergunta por trás de cada demanda, traduzi-la em modelos de dados e indicadores, e ir além do "o quê" para explicar o "porquê" dos resultados.
Principais responsabilidades

• Construir, testar e documentar modelos de transformação de dados com DBT.

• Desenvolver e otimizar consultas SQL e modelos dimensionais e relacionais no BigQuery.

• Monitorar e otimizar performance e custo de processamento no BigQuery.

• Construir, manter e orquestrar pipelines de dados no Airflow.

• Desenvolver dashboards e modelos semânticos no Looker Platform.

• Levantar requisitos com stakeholders de negócio e traduzi-los em soluções de dados.

• Conduzir análises de causa-raiz e propor soluções baseadas em insights.

• Documentar e taguear ativos de dados, promovendo boas práticas de governança.

• Automatizar tarefas e realizar análises exploratórias com Python.

Requisitos obrigatórios

• Experiência sólida como Engenheiro Analítico, Engenheiro de BI ou função similar.

• Domínio de SQL avançado, incluindo otimização de queries e modelagem dimensional e relacional.

• Experiência avançada com DBT na construção, testes e documentação de pipelines de transformação.

• Experiência com Airflow na construção, manutenção e orquestração de pipelines complexos.

• Conhecimento aprofundado em BigQuery, incluindo performance, gestão de custos e recursos avançados da plataforma.

• Familiaridade com outros serviços de dados do GCP, como Google Cloud Storage.

• Proficiência no desenvolvimento de dashboards no Looker Platform.

Diferenciais

• Conhecimento em Python para automação, pipelines customizados e/ou análises exploratórias.

• Familiaridade com métricas de produto (AARRR), marketing (LTV, CAC) ou financeiras.

• Experiência com práticas de governança de dados, como documentação e tagueamento de ativos.

Competências comportamentais

• Perfil consultivo, com facilidade para conduzir conversas com stakeholders não técnicos.

• Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados.

• Pensamento analítico e crítico, com foco em entender a causa-raiz dos problemas.

• Forte cultura de documentação e organização das próprias entregas.

• Autonomia para atuar em ambiente 100% remoto.

title: Power Electronics Engineer

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

- Architect a breakthrough energy technology - Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

- Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion - Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

- Move fast and build what matters - Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

Join our team to work on cutting-edge power conversion technologies, developing solutions that combine high power density, high voltage and current, fast dynamic response, and demanding efficiency and reliability requirements. In this role, you will translate functional and system requirements into robust power-stage solutions. Your work will contribute to optimizing efficiency, thermal performance, reliability, scalability, and power density. You will work closely with colleagues across integrated electronics, embedded software, mechanical, thermal, and system engineering.

- Design and develop magnetic components such as inductors, transformers, and chokes, including selection of magnetic materials, core geometries, winding concepts, and evaluation of losses and thermal limitations.

- Develop analytical and simulation models to evaluate converter behaviour, semiconductor stresses, switching and conduction losses, efficiency, and performance across relevant operating conditions.

- Build prototypes and perform laboratory testing, characterization, verification, troubleshooting, and validation of power electronic circuits and converter stages.

- Analyse test results and correlate measurements with simulations and calculations to identify design improvements and validate converter performance.

WHO YOU ARE

- You hold a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field.

- You are experienced in taking power-stage designs from initial concept and simulation through component selection, prototype implementation, laboratory measurement, debugging, and validation.

- You are an expert in power conversion topologies, power semiconductors, magnetic components, and passive components.

- Experience with electro-thermal simulation tools such as PLECS is a plus.

- Experience with SiC or GaN semiconductors, high-frequency magnetics is a plus.

- Technical Screening (30 min)

- Technical Panel (3x60 min)

THE ROLE

Sardine makes risk and payment decisions for banks and fintechs. Our customers audit us closely, and application security is a large part of what they examine.

Money moves through this platform, so real adversaries study it. Your job is to find what they would find, especially authorization flaws and business logic abuse, and then make the whole class of bug go away.

The application security team is small. The estate is large: Go, Node.js, Python, Ruby, and Java services running on multi-cloud and Kubernetes. That ratio shapes the work. Findings arrive from scanners, code review, testing, threat modeling, pentesters, and bug bounty hunters. You turn that stream into a pipeline that validates, routes, and closes issues with as little manual effort as possible. Little here is pre-decided. You determine where the risk is and go after it.

MAKING BUG CLASSES GO AWAY

- Spot the patterns across findings and remove the root cause, not just the instance

- Set the secure patterns and defaults that make the right way the easy way

- Write custom static analysis rules for our own anti-patterns, so a fixed bug class stays fixed

- Review platform-layer controls (authorization, service identity, secrets handling, gateway enforcement), find the gaps, and push the owning teams until they are closed

- Work alongside engineers on fixes that are simple, get adopted, and hold

- Threat modeling on new and high-exposure designs

- Security enablement across engineering, including a security champions program

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

title: SDK Engineer - Python
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a SDK Engineer - Python to join our SDK team and own how developers talk to Supabase from Python. You'll work closely with the rest of the SDK team, our Auth, Realtime, Storage, PostgREST, Functions, CLI and Docs teams, and the open-source community, helping us make the Python SDK a library Python developers genuinely enjoy using.

Python developers reach Supabase from backend services, data pipelines, notebooks, and a growing number of AI agents and agent frameworks. The Python SDK is how all of them talk to the platform: database queries, auth, storage, realtime and edge functions, in both sync and async flavors.

This is a library-authoring role, and the work happens in the open: public repos, public issue trackers, and API decisions whose consequences last for years. If you get satisfaction from a type checker that catches the bug before your users do, from an async client that cleans up after itself, and from an issue tracker that isn't a graveyard, you'll like it here.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Build and evolve our Python SDK across database, auth, storage, realtime and functions, with both sync and async APIs that feel natural in Python.

- Start new things. Alongside the maintenance work, find what's missing, make the case for it, and build it. Nobody will hand you the list.

- Work in the open. Triage inbound issues, review and shepherd outside contributions, keep CI and release automation healthy, and hold a clear, kind line on scope.

- Own the typing experience. Make the SDK fully typed and checker-friendly, so autocomplete and static analysis stay correct in real codebases.

- Keep us honest across environments. Multiple Python versions, sync and async frameworks, workers, serverless and notebooks - with dependency ranges that don't fight our users' projects. Test it, don't assume it.

- Work on realtime. Long-lived websocket connections, reconnection, and subscription and presence semantics.

- Track the platform. When auth, realtime, storage, postgrest or edge functions ship a change, make sure the SDK reflects it, and that we say so in the changelog.

- Design in public. Write the RFCs, migration guides, release notes and docs. Treat a breaking change as a deprecation path plus a migration story, not a version bump.

- Make our SDK legible to AI coding agents, which are now a major consumer of it.

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

- Know modern Python typing deeply. You use generics, protocols, overloads and TypedDict as design tools, run strict type checking, and fix type errors without reaching for Any.

- Have authored or maintained a published library with a public API and users outside your own company. You know what it costs to change something people depend on.

- Know the maintainer side of open source. Issue triage at volume, reviewing outside PRs, release automation, changelogs and semver, security reports, and saying no to a feature request without losing the person who asked.

- Are fluent in asyncio and have opinions on how a library should serve both sync and async callers.

- Know Python packaging for libraries: pyproject.toml, wheels, modern tooling, version support policy, and why libraries shouldn't pin their dependencies tightly.

- Test as a habit: unit, type-level and end-to-end against a real stack. Every fix comes with a regression test.

- Write well. Design docs, changelogs and issue replies are a large part of the output here, much of it public, and we're async by default.

title: Analytics Engineer, Finance and Modeling
description:
At In Tandem , we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands-OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator-we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods. We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments. If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.

As an Analytics Engineer (Finance & Modeling) , you'll own the metrics, reporting and reconciliation our financial decisions rest on, turning subscription and transaction data across OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall and Custody Navigator into numbers the business can defend. As that foundation becomes automatic, the work shifts toward forecasting and modeling.

You won't start from scratch. Our dbt project is live on Databricks with a star-schema finance mart in production and documented in Unity Catalog. What's missing is the layer on top, and that layer is yours. We also run an internal AI agent that answers business questions in Slack off the semantic layer, so every metric you define and test becomes a question Finance can ask directly rather than queue.

What you'll accomplish:

•
Governed metrics. Add the definitions the finance mart doesn't have yet (ARR, renewal rate, churn, CAC), versioned in dbt and documented in Unity Catalog, with the tests that make each one defensible, and wired into the agent so Finance can ask them directly.

•
Reporting Finance can run without you. Move the recurring finance pack into marimo, retire the Tableau views behind it, and turn a monthly hand-build into something that runs on a schedule.

•
Numbers that reconcile. Reconcile transactions across the app stores, payment processors, subscription systems and the ledger, with automated checks that alert rather than surface at close. Route discrepancies upstream with the evidence attached and turn each one into a test. You build the checks and escalate. Accounting owns the treatment.

•
Forecasting for Finance. Cohort subscriber and revenue projection, and aggregate renewal and retention forecasting, feeding the CFO's forecast and board reporting. LTV by acquisition source, feeding paid spend allocation with Growth. Pricing and promo impact, modeled before we ship rather than measured after. Individual churn propensity and uplift follow once there's a retention motion ready to act on the scores.

• Models ship as scored tables in dbt and Unity Catalog, with tests, lineage and a definition the agent can answer from. Not as notebooks.

Who you are:

• Statistically rigorous. You know why a cohort curve is the wrong shape, what a model is leaking, and when a result is noise.

• Fluent in finance, and unwilling to let a number you can't explain go out the door. When two systems disagree, you find out why and tell the people upstream.

• An engineer who owns the number end to end, from a CFO's question through the model, the test, the report and the conversation that follows. A spreadsheet nobody can reproduce reads to you as a liability.

• AI-proficient in practice, not in theory. Claude Code, coding agents and agent SDKs are part of our daily loop, and we expect you to already work this way. A lot of what used to be a week of modeling work is now an afternoon, and we're hiring for people who have internalized that.

• Willing to wear several hats. This is a small team supporting four brands. Some weeks you're deep in a retention model, some weeks you're chasing an app store discrepancy or unblocking someone else's dashboard. The scope above is the center of the role, not a fence around it.

• Motivated by work that matters. Families rely on these products during real moments in their lives.

Au sein de ce centre, vous conjuguez passion scientifique et impact sociétal, « en décortiquant » la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux.
Grâce à des outils d’élaboration et de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nous déployons le concept de «Material by design» : concevoir au mieux les matériaux de demain répondant aux enjeux de transition.
Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe.

Ce post-doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet VARIMA (VAlorisation des Résidus d’Incinération en Matériaux Avancés) du dispositif Partenariats d'innovation Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes - volet Preuves de Concept. L’incinération des déchets ménagers produit, en plus de l'énergie, des résidus contenant des métaux et des minéraux. Des entreprises récupèrent et recyclent les différents métaux. Cependant, des milliers de tonnes de poussières minérales sont générées et sont généralement envoyées en décharge faute de solution de valorisation.
Ce post-doctorat, d’une durée de 18 mois vise à étudier la valorisation des poussières d’incinération par deux voies d’élaboration : voie géopolymères et voie métallurgie des poudres. Les matériaux obtenus seront ensuite caractérisés au niveau microstructural mais aussi au niveau des propriétés d’usage (propriétés mécanique et thermique ainsi que la tenue à la lixiviation). Le post-doctorant.e contribuera durant la deuxième année de ce CDD à une étude d’impact relative au procédés développés.

The results are concrete: 7-40x faster training, performance as if trained on 10x+ more raw data, and models with less than half the parameters beating larger ones. AI labs and enterprises use it to train and adapt their own models.
Our client has raised ~$60M across Seed and Series A, led by Felicis and Amplify Partners, with Radical Ventures, Microsoft, and Amazon. Angels include Geoff Hinton, Yann LeCun, and Jeff Dean. The team is growing fast on the back of a strong enterprise pipeline.

Every company should own its intelligence. Our client wants every AI team - not just the frontier labs - to have frontier-quality training data and full control over the cost and roadmap of their own models.
The Opportunity

You'll sit on the marketing team and work directly with the co-founder on content strategy and execution, with direct access to the researchers and engineers doing the work. No legacy playbook, no layers of approval - and an AI community that's already paying attention.

Expose manufacturing defects in Graphcore’s advanced circuit boards with tests you build and deploy.

Based in Bristol, UK, you’ll develop board and PCBA hardware tests that help turn complex designs into reliable products. You’ll take tests from initial design analysis to deployment, then support them in factories and the field.

• Strong electronics fundamentals, particularly digital electronics.

• Commercial experience in board or PCBA hardware testing.

• Understanding of manufacturing test for advanced electronic systems.

• Knowledge of surface-mount technology (SMT), PCB manufacturing processes and their failure mechanisms.

title: Lead Data Scientist, AdTech
description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato .

YOUR ROLE
You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.
Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.
We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.
By the end of your first year:

• Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier

• Carrier conversion data running in production models

• Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale

• A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions

• Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives

• Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

• 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact

• Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.

• You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included

• You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift

• You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view

• Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

• Real ad budget spent in live auctions

• Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems

• Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms

• Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration

• Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior

• AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker

• CI/CD deployment

title: Cloud Architect Internship
description:
Overview: Multi-Tenant Cloud Infrastructure Design
The Cloud Architect is responsible for designing, managing, and optimizing the entire multi-tenant cloud infrastructure that hosts our integrated supply chain e-commerce platform. While our current stack utilizes Oracle Cloud Free VMs, this role requires expertise in major public clouds (AWS/GCP/Azure) to architect scalable, resilient, cost-optimized, and compliant solutions that handle fluctuating e-commerce traffic, stable internal tool usage, and intensive AI agent compute demands.
Internship Details
Duration: 3 months
Start Date: Immediate
Location: Remote
Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.
Key Responsibilities & Core Projects
You will design and govern the platform's foundation, ensuring scalability and compliance across all environments.

• Cloud Architecture Design: Design and evolve the target cloud infrastructure (utilizing AWS, GCP, or Azure best practices) for maximum scalability, security, and high-availability, ensuring the platform can reliably support the MES $\rightarrow$ WMS $\rightarrow$ OMS flow.

• Capacity Planning & Optimization: Plan and optimize resource allocation to effectively handle unpredictable e-commerce traffic spikes and the specific compute requirements for AI agent training and inference, driving cost efficiency.

• High Availability & Disaster Recovery (DR): Implement multi-region/multi-AZ high-availability architectures and define comprehensive Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies for all core services, including PostgreSQL 15 and Redis.

• Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) Governance: Establish and enforce best practices for Terraform usage, ensuring configuration consistency, security compliance, and auditable infrastructure changes.

• Security & Compliance: Conduct regular security reviews of cloud configurations (e.g., IAM, VPC/VNet, Storage) and ensure architecture aligns with data residency and compliance requirements relevant to our multi-tenant operations.

• Service Integration: Architect the network and service mesh overlay that integrates the containerized applications (Docker/Traefik) with external cloud services and the overall monitoring solution (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).

Required Technologies & Tools
Candidates must possess deep architectural experience with public cloud providers and infrastructure automation:

• Cloud Providers: Expert-level proficiency in at least one major public cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

• Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Mandatory expertise in Terraform for cloud resource provisioning.

• Containerization: Deep knowledge of Docker networking, security, and orchestration principles.

• Networking & Edge: Experience configuring load balancing, service mesh, and ingress controllers (e.g., Traefik).

• Data & Storage: Architecting scalable database services (PostgreSQL) and object storage (MinIO).

• Security: Cloud security best practices, IAM policy design, and network segmentation.

AI Agent Focus
You will optimize the cloud layer for our emerging AI capabilities.

• Compute Optimization: Design elastic and cost-effective compute clusters (e.g., GPU instances) to efficiently handle the variable demands of LLM fine-tuning and multi-agent system orchestration.

• Data Residency: Architect the data pipeline and storage solutions to ensure that training data and model artifacts adhere to strict data residency requirements across tenants.

Success Metrics & Career Path
Performance will be measured by:

• Cost Efficiency: Demonstrable reduction in cloud operational costs (FinOps) while maintaining performance.

• Availability: Achieving defined SLAs/SLOs for infrastructure uptime and performance.

• Compliance: Successful implementation and auditing of cloud security and data residency controls.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Solution Architect or Head of Technology, collabo

As an SRE you will live at the boundary between development and operations, applying strong software engineering principles to infrastructure and operations problems, and continually pushing the platform toward higher reliability with lower operational toil. WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

- Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant - Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

- Build real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world - Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

- Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

As a Senior Computational Physicist - Stellarator Optimization, you will design the magnetic fields and coils at the core of our stellarators. Your work will directly shape Stellaris, our first commercial fusion power plant.

Gas Technical support Officer Job Description:

About Gas Safe Register

Gas Safe Register is the official gas registration body for the United Kingdom, Isle of Man, Jersey and Guernsey. By law, gas businesses and engineers must be registered to carry out gas work legally. The register helps protect the public from unsafe gas work by maintaining the official list of competent businesses and engineers, supporting inspections, investigating safety concerns and raising awareness of gas safety standards.

Capita delivers the Gas Safe Register service under a concession arrangement with the Health and Safety Executive and related authorities. Together, we help maintain gas safety standards and give consumers confidence that gas work is carried out safely, legally and professionally.

Why Join Us?

• Use your technical gas experience in a role focused on advice, guidance and public protection.

• Move into a varied support role where no two enquiries are the same.

• Influence safety awareness by helping stakeholders, gas businesses and the public understand key requirements.

• Contribute to technical publications, guidance and bulletins that support the wider industry.

• Join a service with a clear purpose: helping improve and maintain gas safety standards across the UK.

description:
ABOUT COLUMN

For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand - builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.

At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!

THE OPPORTUNITY:

Column's Compliance team plays a critical role in ensuring the Bank grows safely. As a Compliance Analyst, you will be responsible for supporting the Compliance Testing function, leveraging regulatory compliance expertise to ensure our fintech partners’ programs are compliant and sustainable and meet the Bank’s expectations. This is a cross-functional role, working with both first- and second-line colleagues and interfacing directly with our fintech partners. This means exposure to a range of products, business models, and regulatory questions you won’t find at a traditional bank. This role is a great opportunity for someone who is passionate about regulatory compliance and wants hands-on experience testing a wide variety of fintech products, partners, and business models to accelerate their compliance career.

This role is a fixed-term contract, remote position with an initial contract duration of six months and the potential to extend based on performance.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Conduct compliance testing, both across Column’s products and services and at the Bank’s partners, as a contributor to Column’s Compliance Testing & Monitoring Program

- Clearly document assessment findings, and own the drafting and reporting of results derived from the Compliance Testing Program

- Identify potential areas of weakness (inadequate/ineffective controls, areas of non-compliance, etc.) within the Bank, and work with partners to strengthen the associated control environment

- Monitor, interpret, and assess potential regulatory changes that may impact the Bank. Work with business, risk, and legal partners to ensure new regulatory requirements are clearly understood and processes are in place before their effective dates

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL:

- Bachelor’s degree and/or equivalent experience

- 3+ years in compliance or audit; experience at a regulated financial institution is a plus

- Detail-oriented with excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills

- Experience navigating banking regulations and applying rules to the Bank’s products

- Demonstrated project management skills and the ability to juggle execution across multiple stakeholders

- Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager (CRCM), Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS), or equivalent certification a plus

- Curiosity, eagerness to learn, and excitement about regulatory compliance and partner banking

WHAT YOU'LL GET FROM US:

- 🏥 Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans, including options that are 100% covered by Column for you

- 💳 FSA and HSA account options to enable use of pre-tax money for medical and dependent care expenses

- 🌴 Paid PTO, including 15 days of vacation and 10 days of sick leave each year

- 📈 Eligibility to participate in Column’s 401k plan, including self-directed brokerage options
